title: Evaluate only the project information a tool needs
goal: Choose property-only, item or full MSBuild evaluation when a project-inspection tool needs evaluated information without unnecessary later passes, and verify the available state against full evaluation.

selectionNotes: The host framework and SDK are independent of the project being inspected. This net11 host really evaluates an imported net10 project.
SDK10 retains a verified full-evaluation alternative but has no ProjectEvaluationStage API. No older-target partial route or new .NET10 foundation is advertised.
Partial state is guarded: RC2 Targets.Count throws rather than returning zero. Use Full for target discovery and execution.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Exact qualified external MSBuild host runtime. Actual GA remains unqualified.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Compile and execute against the complete matching installed SDK/MSBuild 18.12.0-1.26504.105 closure and SDK resolver.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Compiled host language baseline; no preview-language opt-in or particular newer syntax is necessary for partial evaluation.

packages.name: Microsoft.Build.Locator
packages.reason: Actual independent net8.0 package asset, locked with no transitive packages; register before MSBuild types load.

packageAssets: Installed SDK Microsoft.Build.dll and Microsoft.Build.Framework.dll are compilation references with Private=false; all runtime MSBuild, NuGet helpers, resolvers, Sdks and targets come from that same complete installed SDK. No Microsoft.Build NuGet replacement.
Locator1.11.2 net8.0 asset is used in both host targets. Its net46 asset is not qualified here.
platforms: Windows x64; exact .NET-hosted SDK/runtime/reference closure. Other OSes and Visual Studio/.NET Framework hosts are outside this evidence.
prerequisites: Install the complete exact SDK/runtime from official .NET distributions; a lone DLL is insufficient. Use exact global.json with rollForward=disable and allowPrerelease=true.

Launch the host DLL through the matching absolute dotnet executable; the bootstrap derives the SDK path from that executable. Register Locator before loading MSBuild types, and use one SDK per disposable process.

Use trusted project/import inputs. PowerShell7 is needed for repository evidence/inspection; Node22.19+ and SDK10 are additionally needed for packed-tool inspection. Inspect inherited build/package configuration.
constraints: Properties includes imports and property evaluation, so it is not an untrusted-project sandbox. Evaluation and target execution are separate.
At Properties, Items/GetItems throw; at every partial stage Targets.Count throws. Mutable Project rejects partial options; Full remains the default.
SDK10 uses full evaluation for the comparison. No older-host partial API, package substitution, workload, NativeAOT/trimming, apphost, server-reuse, performance or actual-GA claim.
The complete offline recipe is embedded; retrieving it executes no consumer code and changes no project.
stabilityLimitations: Exact RC2 preview evidence is not actual GA. PIN-959/PIN-963 and unrelated Human gates remain open.
The API is not labelled experimental and needs no -mt switch. Preview7 target-count prose is superseded by actual RC2 getter guards.
